2_motivation: quotes the batch-4 prior-art verdict row (a) verbatim (see "Prior-art verdict quoted" below) and B3 part 7's open question — "whether an ACHIEVABLE gain head … recovers most of it. If yes, the round's affirmative value-of-LF evidence largely reduces to an output-calibration trick that costs no LF data at all … if no, LF supplies a calibration signal that 5 HF rows provably cannot". The card delivers the *measured absorbed share*, never a head.
3_description:
new probe family `models_r2/r2s3_b4_substitution/`, `epochs 0`, seed 0, no training and no GPU maths. Reads B3's 33 leg result JSONs (exact `rel_l2_per_sample`, floor splits), B3's 33 `*_preds.npz` dumps (`pred_test`, `cond_test_raw`, `pred_hf_train`, `target_hf_train`, `cond_hf_train_raw`, `selected_train_rows`), HF test targets through `round2/eval/panel_data.py` (offline reference path), and the two frozen state files. Never opens an LF field.
  **Achievable LF-free control class** (no test targets in any fit): `A0_raw`; `A0 + H_global_train`; `A0 + H_ridge_cond_train` (LOO-λ over the 5 rows); `A0 + H_knn_cond_train`; `ref_linear_hfonly`; `ref_nn_condition_n5`; `ref_train_mean_n5`; `ref_zero`; `A0_split_ensemble` (**labelled non-budget-matched**, 15 HF rows / 3× compute — verdict (b) rides as an arm, never a claim).
  **Ceilings** (TEST-FITTED, labelled on every line, never claims): `C1_global_test`, `C2_ridge_cond_loo_test`, `C3_per_sample_oracle`.
  **Deliverables**: per (dataset, draw) the raw effect, the substituted effect, the ceiling-substituted effect and each absorbed share; the 7-reading claimability recount (`tools/effect_threshold_readings.py`, primary reading `worst_split_vs_mce`); paired per-test-sample bootstrap CIs where the draw axis does not exist; the arm-symmetry column (same heads on A1); the memorization statistics; `tools/map_dispersion_scale_shape.py --ensemble`. Floor arms are reported next to every calibrated variant. Standing caveats carried per row: helmholtz report-only (ADR r2-0004); pfc band-limited denominator; ac/fk/pfc ADR r2-0003 conditional-mean bound + M2 shrinkage reward; everything `provisional-single-seed`.
4_expected_result:
(skill units, corrected denominators, seed 0, `provisional-single-seed`; every figure below **measured in the brainstormer pre-flight** from B3's shipped artifacts unless marked *predicted*):

  | dataset | `E_raw` (draw-mean) | best achievable LF-free control | `E_free` worst draw | vs certified mce | `E_ceil` worst draw (per-sample oracle) |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | `ifc_poisson` | +5.9843 | `ref_linear_hfonly` 3.4744 | **+1.3243** (single native draw) | 0.9377041 → **1.41×** | +0.6106 → **below mce** |
  | `sharp__cahn_hilliard` | +14.7762 | `ref_zero` 23.9217 / `ref_linear_hfonly` 22.959 | **+10.3548** | 0.0912454 → **113×** | +6.632 → **72.7×** |
  | `sharp__allen_cahn_2d` | +298.902 | `ref_zero` 561.482 / `ref_linear_hfonly` 235.983 / `A0` 311.281 | **+23.611** | 0.8797047 → **26.8×** | −29.44 → **sign reversal** |
  | `sharp__fisher_kpp_2d` | +1.3132 | `ref_train_mean_n5` 12.865–13.162 | **−2.568** | fails on sign | −2.568 |
  | `sharp__phase_field_crystal_2d` | −2.5588 | `A0` / split-ensemble 54.55 | **−10.7** | fails on sign (M2 predicted) | −11.74 |
  | `ext__helmholtz_2d` (report-only) | +5.7169 | `ref_zero` 3.3441 | **−2.615** | fails on sign; report-only regardless | −2.615 |

  *Predicted* additions the card measures: the achievable heads add **≈ 0.00** on every leg (the arms interpolate their 5 HF train rows — per-sample optimal scale 1.0000 on 5/5 rows, train rel-L2 0.0005–0.0026 — so the train-fitted heads are the identity); the decisive unknown is `C2_ridge_cond_loo_test` on `ifc_poisson`, bracketed by `C1_global_test` (0% absorbed, actively harmful: 8.1344 → 8.1844) and `C3_per_sample_oracle` (89.8% absorbed), with a documented prior of LOO-linear R² = 0.919 on exactly this dataset's 5-D condition vector (`tools/residual_gain_learnability.py` header, round-1 `s1_poisson-B2`) — I predict 60–90% on ifc and 20–45% on ch.
  **Net expected finding**: under the achievable-control gate the criterion-1 claimable set becomes **{ch 113×, ac 26.8×, ifc 1.41×}** — still three datasets but different membership from B3's {ifc, ch, fk}, with fk retiring; under the ceiling gate only **{ch}** survives. Anchor context: the stream anchor is the best-floor panel geomean **23.063616857615774**; B3's primary arm landed at 17.115.
expected_falsification: FALSIFIED if fewer than 2 of {ifc, ch, ac} keep an LF advantage over the **best achievable LF-free control** above their certified `min_claimable_effect` on **every** draw (ifc 0.9377041289531141 + a paired per-test-sample bootstrap CI excluding zero, since its single native draw makes it mce-only by construction; ch 0.09124535322300886; ac 0.8797047190126648), or if the ceiling-corrected advantage on `sharp__cahn_hilliard` falls below 0.09124535322300886 on any draw — with the predicted ceiling failures on ifc (+0.611 < 0.9377) and ac (sign reversal) pre-registered as the card's *finding*, plus F3 (the 5-row memorization mechanism: falsified if median |log per-sample optimal scale| on the train rows exceeds 0.05 on ≥2 of 6 datasets) and F4 (instrument seam: dump-recomputed skills must match B3's per-leg record to 1e-3 relative — pre-flight max observed 1.31e-4 — and full-row floors must match `state/anchors/floors.json` at 1e-9).

prior_art.verdict_quote: > **(a)** LF-free **gain/amplitude head** conditioned on the condition vector, fitted on the same 5 HF rows, used as a **substitution test** for LF's train-time value (training-free probe on shipped dumps first, then one confirmatory arm) | **preempted-but-MF-composition-open** | https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09143 (**curl-fetched**; DiSOL Methods §4.1: per-sample amplitude u_lim, dimensionless pattern, "optional **amplitude regressor**" — the mechanism verbatim, in PDE operator learning); https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.01341 (**curl-fetched**; LCC = affine de-shrinkage on a small held-out calibration split, Tweedie local de-shrinkage, no new labels, domain-general); https://distill.pub/2018/feature-wise-transformations/ (search return; FiLM γ = learned scale, "specialized HyperNetwork"); https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20771 (**curl-fetched**; controlled amplitude normalization + "mean relative L² … may obscure"); https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.03365 (**curl-fetched**; control-baseline discipline) | Only the **composition**: using the head as a **control that prices auxiliary low-fidelity training data**. No retrieved MF ablation output-scale-corrects its single-fidelity baseline (turn 4 t1), and the direct query "is the auxiliary-data gain just calibration?" returned **no usable results** (turn 3 t2). Plus the round's four standing openers: condition-vector-only test input with genuine coarse consistent solves at train; N_hf = 5; the **copy-LF denominator**; a panel varying condition completeness (ADR r2-0003). **The deliverable is the measured share of the ±LF effect the LF-free head absorbs — never the head itself.**
prior_art.supporting_rows_quote: Also honoured: row (b) `preempted-but-MF-composition-open` (weak) — the ensemble "carries as a control arm, not a claim"; row (c) `preempted` — Bouthillier et al. adopted as the card's statistics section and cited, not carded; row (S) `preempted (cite)` — the regime is LUPI / privileged-information distillation (Mazloom et al., DOI 10.1016/j.engappai.2025.113398, metadata-only citation).

recipe.base_family: none (training-free diagnostic probe; no model family is trained or scored. Reads ONLY r2s3_lf_train_signal-B3's shipped artifacts, build_commit dfcd46c6b51b5fe0bd533b9c670a7cdbf9d13830, job 66196690. NO round-1 reuse of any kind; reuses only round2/eval/panel_data.py + eval/nrmse.py read-only and four tools/ probes adapted to round-2 paths)

env._note: keys prefixed _ are card directives, NOT passed to --env. The --env set is exactly the 27 R2S3B4_* keys above. epochs=0: the probe trains nothing and calls no optimizer; score_panel.py is NOT the entry point (round-1 epochs-0 precedent: s2_beyond_copy-B1). Tools to adapt to round-2 eval paths and re-promote via the register turn: tools/residual_gain_learnability.py, tools/gain_calibration_ceiling.py, tools/effect_threshold_readings.py, tools/map_dispersion_scale_shape.py — their round-1 headers point at round1/eval/panel_data.py.
env._walltime: --time 00:40:00. Basis: the brainstormer pre-flight computed 9 of the 33 legs (ch x3, ac x3, ifc, fk, pfc) including per-sample oracle scales and target loads in under 4 minutes on the login node; the full job is numpy-only and I/O-bound over 4.1 GB of dumps. CPU-only: no GPU maths is performed. Partition/gres per project.yaml; the orchestrator may drop the gres request since no CUDA kernel is launched.
env._memory: R2S3B4_STREAM_PER_DATASET=1 means one dataset is resident at a time (largest: allen_cahn 6 legs x 100 x 65536 float32 + targets ~200 MB).
env._no_lf_assert: the probe must RAISE if any code path opens an LF field or any file under stripped-out LF keys; every output JSON records lf_read_anywhere=false, field_input_at_test=false, trained_parameters=0.
env._declared_baseline: program.md 12.3's mandatory declared baseline mf_fno_transfer_film is CITED, not re-run (ifc_poisson, 200 ep, seed 0, nRMSE 0.055637439592454, skill 1.5454844331237223, hashes d3d0ade9... / 9753ff24..., from r2s3-B1). This card trains nothing, so the rebadge question is answered by construction: no family is created.

build_notes: Family dir models_r2/r2s3_b4_substitution/: manifest.json (diagnostic: true), run_diagnostic.py (entry point), heads.py, controls.py, readings.py, lf_guard.py, paths.py, INSPIRATION.md. NO smoke_eval.py and NO checkpoint contract: card_type diagnostic, recipe.epochs = 0, nothing is trained and score_panel.py is not the entry point (recipe.env._note). base_family is 'none' per the recipe, so no zoo family was copied or modified.

SMOKE TEST (full panel, in-session, login node, 2026-08-01): `source .venv/bin/activate; cd <worktree>; source scratchpad/smoke_env.sh; python models_r2/r2s3_b4_substitution/run_diagnostic.py --datasets ifc_poisson,sharp__cahn_hilliard,sharp__fisher_kpp_2d,sharp__allen_cahn_2d,sharp__phase_field_crystal_2d,ext__helmholtz_2d --out scratchpad/smoke/contract_smoke.json --env "${R2S3B4_ENV[@]}"` -> exit 0 in ~896 s over all 32 legs. Result JSON: worktrees/r2s3_lf_train_signal/B4/scratchpad/smoke/contract_smoke.json (log: scratchpad/smoke/full.log). Every value finite. Measured E_raw (draw-mean) / E_free (worst draw): ifc 5.9843 / 1.3243; ch 14.7762 / 10.3550; fk 1.3132 / -2.5672; ac 298.9024 / 23.6415; pfc -2.5588 / -10.6588; hz 5.7168 / -2.6149 -- all reproduce the card's part-4 pre-registered table (brainstormer pre-flight) to <= 3e-2 absolute on the largest-magnitude leg. E_ceil on A0 at the per-sample oracle, worst draw: ifc +0.6106, ch +6.6325, ac -29.4396, pfc -11.7416 -- the card's quoted column, exactly. F1 passing set {ifc, ch, ac} (falsified false); F3 fires nowhere (max median |log c| = 1.6e-4 << 0.05); F4 max arm-skill rel diff 6.2e-16 (tol 1e-3) and all full-row floors match state/anchors/floors.json exactly at 1e-9.

HYPERPARAMETER PROVENANCE: every knob is read from recipe.env -- paths.need() raises on a missing knob and paths.parse_env() raises on an unknown R2S3B4_* key, so a typo in the sbatch script cannot fall back to a built-in default. Nothing is invented. Two CONVENTIONS were inherited from the round's promoted tools rather than guessed, and are cited in heads.py: (i) log-space gain fits with PRESS-LOO lambda selection and an unpenalised intercept follow tools/gain_calibration_ceiling.py::_ridge_loo; (ii) R2S3B4_HEAD_CLIP is applied ONLY to the law-keyed heads (ridge_cond_train, knn_cond_train, ridge_cond_loo_test), exactly as that tool clips only its x_linear_law -- the exact minimisers (global_train, global_test, per_sample_oracle) are unclipped, because clipping an exact minimiser stops it being the bound it is defined to be. Selection rules the card left implicit and the code makes explicit + labelled: knn k in R2S3B4_KNN_K chosen by exact LOO over the 5 rows (ties -> smallest k); the 'best achievable control' is chosen BY ITS TEST SCORE (generous to the LF-free class, conservative about LF) and says so in the JSON; the F3 per-dataset statistic is the MAX over that dataset's legs (the reading most likely to fire, i.e. least favourable to the card's own mechanism claim).

PATH RESOLUTION (a real hazard, handled): repo-relative recipe.env paths are resolved against the MAIN repo root via `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`, NOT the worktree. The worktree was forked at round2-substrate 9e10d41, whose state/noise_floor.json is the PROVISIONAL file (ifc mce 0.2399 vs the certified 0.9377 the card's F1 quotes). run_diagnostic.py raises if the noise-floor file it reads carries _provisional: true, so a stale copy can never silently change a falsification verdict.

_no_lf_assert ENFORCEMENT + its one honest caveat: HF test targets come through round2/eval/panel_data.py (the card's offline reference path). The frozen factory loader materialises every fidelity in one call and has no HF-only mode, and the eval layer is byte-immutable during the round, so lf_guard.py copies out the HF field and immediately replaces every non-HF field_by_fid / cond_by_fid entry with a poison object that raises LFAccessError on any use (indexing, iteration, len, numpy coercion, arithmetic). Every output JSON carries lf_read_anywhere=false, field_input_at_test=false, trained_parameters=0 and the audit counter lf_touch_attempts (0 across all six datasets in the smoke). The JSON states plainly that the claim is 'no LF value entered any computation', not 'the frozen loader never touched an LF file on disk' -- the latter is not achievable without editing the eval layer.

INSTRUMENT SEAMS (F4 is enforced inline; the probe RAISES rather than degrading): (a) every leg's dump-recomputed skill vs B3's recorded per-leg skill at R2S3B4_SEAM_TOL_REL; (b) the full-row floors read back from B3's leg JSONs vs state/anchors/floors.json at R2S3B4_FLOOR_TOL; (c) the four LF-free floors are REBUILT from the dumped 5 HF rows (definitions vendored from B3's refs.py / affine_probe.py, build_commit dfcd46c6) and seam-checked against B3's recorded rel_l2_mean -- observed rel diff exactly 0.0 on ifc; this rebuild is what gives the floors PER-SAMPLE arrays, without which F1's ifc bootstrap requirement is unanswerable since B3 shipped floors as scalars only; (d) the in-probe 7-reading recount is cross-checked against tools/effect_threshold_readings.py run as a subprocess on the RAW contrast of every dataset (max abs diff 0.0 observed) and the split-ensemble skill against tools/map_dispersion_scale_shape.py --ensemble (rel diff 0.0). A mismatch raises; a tool that cannot launch is recorded as 'unavailable' rather than silently skipped.

SLURM: CPU-ONLY. No CUDA kernel is launched anywhere, so 01_train_eval.sh omits --gres (recipe.env._walltime authorises exactly this). --partition stays at project.yaml's `gpu` (slurm_rules.md forbids invented partitions); dropping only the gres takes CPU cores on a GPU node and leaves its GPUs allocatable. IF the site rejects a gres-less job on partition gpu, the cluster default CPU partition `expansion` is the drop-in fallback -- flagged here for the orchestrator rather than taken unilaterally. --time 00:40:00 per recipe.env._walltime (measured: 896 s for the full panel on a contended login node, 15 min, ~2.7x headroom); --mail-user=ezeng@caltech.edu --mail-type=END,FAIL; --requeue set. The 27 --env knobs were diffed programmatically against recipe.env: 27/27 keys present, zero value mismatches, zero extras; the _-prefixed recipe keys are card directives and are NOT passed.

NO submit_seeds_2_3.sh: card_type diagnostic runs once with no seeds 1-2 (SCHEMA.md; project.yaml seed_protocol.seeds = [0]). The probe has no stochastic training and its only randomness -- the paired per-test-sample bootstrap -- is pinned by recipe R2S3B4_BOOTSTRAP_SEED=0, so a second seed would reproduce the first bit-for-bit; 01_train_eval.sh warns if invoked with SEED != 0. Resumability is structural, not checkpoint-based: R2S3B4_STREAM_PER_DATASET=1 writes each substitution_<dataset>.json before the next dataset starts, and a _schema_version guard forces recomputation rather than reusing a sidecar written by different code.

SCOPE HONESTY: the card's part-3 rule is 'each ceiling is applied to every achievable control, and the best is reported', so E_ceil is the best over the whole class x ceiling grid; the card's part-4 TABLE quotes the narrower 'per-sample oracle on A0'. Both are reported -- per_draw.E_ceil (class-wide) and per_draw.ceilings_on_A0_only (the pre-registered column) -- so the analyzer can read the pre-registered number directly without re-deriving it. No TBDs were propagated.
